description: Hash-pinned public artifacts and exact fields supporting the paper's headline Number Game and Rock Diagnosis claims.

Directional GPT-5.4 Mini planner/Gemini target role swap, explicitly not an all-gates confirmation.
Preregistered pooled-support mechanism confirmation.
Post-hoc first-link ranking and leave-one-particle-out audit.

Fresh Qwen planning-tree confirmation on the 33 canonical concepts, including the two-retry composite-null qualifier.
Independent fresh Qwen replication on the 33 canonical concepts, including its complete scientific-primary pass and one-over-cap transport-null qualifier.
Retrospective zero-call robustness synthesis across both independent Qwen canonical cohorts, without rescue of either source composite status.
Retrospective first-link analysis connecting simulated-risk advantage to exact-canonical realized advantage on the fixed 64 Qwen trees.

Retrospective four-block first-link analysis connecting simulated-risk advantage to exact-canonical realized advantage across Qwen and GPT-5.4 Mini planners.

Gemma RockSample[11,11] model replication.

Retrospective stratified synthesis of two independent pooled-Qwen cohorts, preserving the prospective mechanism null.
Retrospective stratified dynamic-support versus fixed-support depth-three synthesis across two pooled-Qwen cohorts.
Fresh preregistered dynamic-support versus fixed-support depth-three result and co-required depth-three versus myopic efficacy.
Fresh powered preregistered dynamic-support Brier primary, co-required depth-three versus myopic efficacy, and mechanics-qualified composite-null boundary.
